import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the dataset with proper column name handling
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t', quotechar='"')

# Define the proportion of gardening-introduced plants
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Convert categorical variables to dummy variables
invaded_niche = pd.get_dummies(invaded_niche, columns=['habitat'])

# Perform a multiple regression analysis
model = ols('prop_gard ~ cropland.1956.50m + urban.1956.50m + elevation + annual.rainfall + habitat_Croplands + habitat_Grasslands + habitat_Shrublands + habitat_Wetlands', data=invaded_niche).fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Load the dataset with proper column name handling
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t', quotechar='"')

# Define the proportion of gardening-introduced plants
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Convert categorical variables to dummy variables
invaded_niche = pd.get_dummies(invaded_niche, columns=['habitat'])

# Perform an ANOVA to test the significance of the interaction between 'cropland.1956.50m' and 'urban.1956.50m'
groups = []
for index, row in invaded_niche.iterrows():
    group = row['cropland.1956.50m'], row['urban.1956.50m']
    groups.append(group)

f_oneway(*groups)
